new_sources.title: From Trajectories to Evidence: Auditable Experimental Records for Industrial Research Agents
new_sources.quantitative_detail_status: Primary PDF directly verified in this run, including Tables 2-5, frozen-memory diagnostics, controller applicability, provenance audits, and online candidate-level lifts.

new_sources.title: Distributed Denial of Science: How Indirect Data Poisoning of AI Systems Can Industrialize Scientific Fraud

candidate_mechanisms.description: Do not persist a multi-round research trajectory or final checkpoint as if it were knowledge. Before consequential handoffs, run bounded context-isolated generate-verify-repair checks for evidence violations and downstream requirements. After execution, group rounds by intervention, check validity and attribution, then admit only qualified Repairs or Guards as frozen records with source context, intervention, measured outcome, supporting evidence, provenance, and applicability boundary; unsupported/confounded findings are withheld. Preserve best validated intermediate evidence independently from chronological recency.
quantitative_evidence: Across 30 industrial paper-to-target adaptations, 26/30 had a later valid round outperform the first, while 22/30 finished below an earlier best valid round.

Bounded context-isolated generate/verify/repair with up to three retries increased proposal-gate acceptance 73.3%→100%, code completeness 92%→97%, and observability 67%→100%; code alignment changed only 50%→52%, showing measurable but incomplete correction.
Provenance audit found 479/479 source-traceable spans and 107/107 source-supported mechanisms; Method-section coverage was 129/139 (92.8%) and Method-block coverage 458/524 (87.4%).
Fourteen candidate claims became 8 Repairs, 1 Guard, and 5 Withheld records; all 34 referenced source artifacts matched archived SHA-256 values.

In 8 paired frozen-memory diagnostics, 5 reference-applicable interventions yielded 3 beneficial, 1 neutral, and 1 harmful outcome; 3 reference Defer/Reject cases yielded 2 harmful and 1 neutral outcomes when manually applied.

On 64 frozen target-record pairs, the semantic applicability controller issued 4 Apply decisions but only 1 matched the reference, for 25% affirmative precision; overall accuracy was 67.2%, below an always-Reject baseline of 79.7% on the imbalanced set, though always-Reject has zero Apply recall and performs no experimentation.

Two production candidates showed +0.75% live-streaming page duration and +6.34% user-growth net-growth utility, but the authors explicitly label these candidate-level online outcomes, not framework-level causal attribution.
candidate_mechanisms.evidence_scope: Industrial recommendation paper-to-target adaptations inside one company. The full workflow has strong system-level/provenance evidence, but same-family generation/verification can share blind spots and the semantic applicability controller was weak. Online lifts lack plain/no-memory parallel controls, so they are candidate-level evidence only.
candidate_mechanisms.decision_relevance: Very high for O: validates the distinction between chronological history and qualified evidence, argues against inheriting the last state merely because it is latest, and provides a structured way to turn experiment outcomes into scoped Repairs/Guards rather than unqualified memories. It also exposes a separate bottleneck: evidence can be valid yet not applicable to a new target, so reuse should be treated as an experimental hypothesis rather than an automatic transfer.

candidate_mechanisms.description: Before an autonomous research agent trusts externally retrieved data, audit provenance using independent signals such as referenced papers, social/contextual markers, statistical anomalies, related datasets, and explicit poisoning cautions. Treat retrieved data integrity as a live inference-time evidence problem, not only a training-data security problem.
quantitative_evidence: Across five socially salient topics, three frontier agent systems, and 450 contained runs, indirect poisoning produced poisoned conclusions in 49.56% of runs while agents detected poisoning in only 6.0%.
A scientist-persona prompt reduced but did not eliminate poisoned conclusions, leaving 16.67% compromised.
The five-check data provenance audit reduced attack success to 0 in the tested runs.
candidate_mechanisms.evidence_scope: Specific indirect-data-poisoning attack using corrupted public datasets and misleading metadata, five topics, three frontier systems. Zero observed success applies only to the tested attack/audit setup and is not proof against arbitrary poisoning or compromised provenance sources.
candidate_mechanisms.decision_relevance: Very high for the external research workers and O feed: primary-source/repository identity alone is not sufficient when data artifacts can be corrupted. Dataset provenance/related-source reconciliation should precede accepting empirical evidence into durable O context.

new_failure_evidence.observation: Research trajectories are explicitly non-monotonic: 26/30 adaptations improved after the first valid round, yet 22/30 ended below an earlier best valid round.
new_failure_evidence.scope: Thirty industrial recommendation adaptations in the primary paper.
new_failure_evidence.implication: O continuation/history should not automatically privilege newest experimental state. Preserve best validated evidence and intervention-level claims independently from chronological recency.

new_failure_evidence.observation: The framework's context-isolated verifier improved several properties, but code alignment barely moved from 50% to 52%; the authors note that same-model-family generation and verification can retain correlated blind spots even without rationale sharing.
new_failure_evidence.implication: Context isolation helps but is not independence. Where failure correlation matters, evaluator/model-family diversity or deterministic/external checks should be tested.

new_failure_evidence.observation: Even among five reference-applicable frozen memories, one application was harmful and one neutral; the learned semantic controller's Apply precision was only 25% on 64 target-record pairs.
new_failure_evidence.scope: Eight paired execution diagnostics and the paper's 64-pair applicability set.
new_failure_evidence.implication: Separate evidence validity from transfer applicability. A validated Repair/Guard should be proposed as a scoped experiment on a new target, not silently promoted to a universal rule.

new_failure_evidence.observation: Agents can reach false scientific conclusions by honestly processing a poisoned public dataset; no malicious prompt, model access, fabricated paper, or trigger phrase is required, and spontaneous detection was only 6.0%.
new_failure_evidence.implication: External research ingestion must verify evidence provenance and cross-source consistency instead of treating successful retrieval/execution as trustworthy evidence.

dead_ends_or_cautions: Do not treat the final or most recent experiment as authoritative merely because it is latest; qualification and best-valid-round preservation are distinct from chronology.
Do not treat qualified memory as automatically reusable. The paper directly shows transfer-applicability errors and harmful applications even for reference-applicable records.
Do not infer the production lifts are caused by the evidence-memory framework; the authors explicitly say candidate-level online performance lacks framework-level causal controls.
Do not generalize the zero-success provenance-audit result to all data poisoning; it is strong evidence for this tested attack class only.
Do not assume a cautious/scientist persona is a sufficient integrity defense; the tested persona left substantial residual compromise.
next_queries: Find controlled methods for transfer/applicability prediction of validated research memories or interventions, including confidence calibration and negative-transfer detection.
Find quantitative research-agent methods for cross-source dataset provenance, statistical anomaly detection, and related-dataset reconciliation beyond the single indirect-poisoning study.
Find systems that preserve best validated intermediate states while continuing exploration, with controlled evidence that this beats final-state-only retention.
Search for cross-model or deterministic verifier ablations showing whether independence reduces correlated blind spots versus context-isolated same-model reviewers.
Search for autonomous research architectures combining qualified evidence records, immutable evaluators, retrieval-time provenance auditing, and applicability gating.
